Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_MountedShooti: Lets a rider aim and fire guns while mounted.
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_WalkPenalty: Hit chance penalty at a walk
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_WalkPenalty_t: Percentage points taken off a gun's hit chance while the horse walks. Standing still has no penalty.
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_TrotPenalty: Hit chance penalty at a trot
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_TrotPenalty_t: Percentage points taken off a gun's hit chance while the horse trots.
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_GallopPenalty: Hit chance penalty at a gallop
Percentage points taken off a gun's hit chance while the horse gallops.
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_AimArc_toolti: How far to either side of the horse's heading the rider can shoot. 180 lets you shoot in every direction, including straight behind; 90 limits you to the front half.
Sandbox_HorseShootAndHitch_TieRadius_too: How far a tied horse can wander from its fence, pole or tree.
